docket_entries.description: LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANT JEFFREY KENT'S CLAIM OF RIGHT TO POSESSION AND NOTICE AFTER HEARING - THE COURT HELD A TRIAL ON THE MATTER. WITNESSES FOR BOTH THE PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT WERE SWORN AND EXAMINED. WRITTEN AND ORAL EVIDENCES WERE PRESENTED IN OPEN COURT. AFTER HEARING THE EVIDENCES, DEFENDANT JEFFREY KENT'S CLAIM OF RIGHT TO POSESSION IS DENIED. PLAINTIFF HAS ESTABLISHED THAT DEFENDANT HAS NOT CARRIED HIS BURDEN. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL A. KAREN, CSR #8189
